messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from a rear three-quarter angle. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the described camera setup and movement, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from a rear three-quarter angle. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character dances in place, shifting her weight, turning, and raising her arms in rhythmic motion.","camera":"A low, near-ground static shot that keeps the character centered from behind.","clothing":"A dark sleeveless crop top with a patterned back, light gray loose trousers, and dark boots.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Long dark hair tied back in a high ponytail that swings with her movement.","identity":"A slender 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, seen mostly from behind.","scene":"A grassy field dotted with small flowers and glowing green sprouts, backed by a row of pink cherry-blossom trees under a blue sky."},"uncertain":["The character's face is not visible, so facial features are unclear.","The exact pattern on the back of the top is hard to make out."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output now shows the character from behind in a low full-body framing, with the cherry-blossom field filling the background and the character centered, matching the reference's rear view and placement. The dance motion continues with similar timing and progression. The red torii and snow-capped mountain from the source front view are no longer visible because the camera is now behind the character.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a full-body rear three-quarter shot, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the character's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and action timing.
uncertain: Facial expression cannot be verified because the character's face is not visible from the rear angle.
unexpected_changes: The character's hair appears dark/black in the output, whereas the source front view showed light/white hair; this may be due to the rear view but is a visible difference.
